verdict.rationale: Zero's MCP documentation lists 'Bulk archive emails' and 'Bulk delete emails' tools, plus a tool to modify email labels, so some batch triage is possible through the MCP server. There is no evidence of multi-selecting conversations in the inbox UI, and it is unclear whether label changes apply in bulk. missing for 10: UI multi-select of conversations, bulk labeling, bulk mark-done, end-user (non-MCP) bulk action docs, hands-on corroboration.
